title: Charlie's unexplained punch-biopsy scar
summary: Charlie Foltz tells of Charlie's unexplained punch-biopsy scar, about after 1976 at Allagash Waterway, Maine, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I have like a small punch biopsy scar up near my scrotum

plain: Charlie Foltz is one of a group of men who say they were taken by alien beings during a 1976 camping trip on the Allagash Waterway, a river route in Maine. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that he has a small round scar near his groin that looks like the mark of a punch biopsy, a medical tool that removes a tiny plug of skin, though he cannot account for it. He tells it as a possible sign that he was examined during the experience.
